prompt: We operate a social platform popular with Brazilian teenagers. What are our current obligations?
assertions: Applies the Digital ECA (Lei 15.211/2025, effective March 17, 2026) to child/adolescent-accessible services

Cites Order CD/ANPD 122/2026 (August 11): platforms with >1 million registered users under 18 in Brazil must publish SEMIANNUAL transparency reports (first covered Jan–Jun 2026, published by Sept 17; thereafter Aug 1/Feb 1 cadence)
Uses the TikTok precedent: R$153.7M for feeds processing minors' data without an adequate legal basis — profiling/recommendation engines need a defensible basis and best-interests analysis
Covers LGPD Art. 14 fundamentals: processing in the child's best interest; specific consent requirements for children's data
Gives an action list: minor-user counting, legal-basis review of feeds/profiling, transparency-report pipeline, deletion readiness
